name: Calm dusk
author: Forge
summary: Slow indigo-to-peach glow, low and gentle.

name: Neon pulse
author: Forge
summary: Four hot neon glows that react hard and move fast.

name: Ember
author: Forge
summary: Warm orange and amber glows, a steady smoulder.

name: Ocean depth
author: Forge
summary: Two deep blue-teal glows drifting slowly.

name: Mono mist
author: Forge
summary: Soft grey and white mist, quiet and neutral.

name: Aurora
author: Forge

name: Bass lift
author: Forge
summary: More low end: up to +5 dB below 100 Hz, tapering off by 400 Hz.

name: Vocal clarity
author: Forge
summary: Trims the lows a little and lifts 1-2.5 kHz so voices sit forward.

name: Late-night low volume
author: Forge
summary: Keeps bass and treble audible when listening quietly, softens the top end.

name: Gentle treble roll-off
author: Forge
summary: A generic, unmeasured curve easing 3-20 kHz down by up to 7 dB for bright headphones.
